name: B&A
introduction: Bernstein & Andriulli is a premier creative management agency and media consultancy. From cultural icons to burgeoning hot new talent, we scout the globe, bringing fresh solutions to the creative community. Our agency works across traditional and pervasive platforms, mindful of the challenges brands face today. Our select collective of strategically insightful creative thinkers are renowned for pushing ideas to extremes and unlocking imaginations. Collaboration is key to how we work, partnering with Sony has been a dream! Each artist has loved creating artwork that is truly unique and answers the brief conceptually and beautifully.
